description: Defines classes, structs, enums, and interfaces for E2SM (E2 Service Model) handling in a 5G RAN context, including control actions, reports, and message processing.

classes.name: e2sm_control_action_executor
classes.description: Abstract base class for executing RIC control actions, providing interface methods for action ID, name, definition, support check, and execution.

classes.name: e2sm_report_service
classes.description: Interface for report services that collect measurements and generate indication messages.

classes.name: e2sm_control_service
classes.description: Interface for control services that manage control actions, support checks, and execution.

classes.name: e2sm_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling packed E2SM messages, including unpacking and packing various definitions.

classes.name: e2sm_interface
classes.description: Interface for managing E2SM services, including packers, supported actions, and control services.

methods.name: get_action_id
methods.description: Returns the identifier for a specific control action.

methods.name: get_action_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the control action.

methods.name: get_control_action_definition
methods.description: Provides the control action definition used in RAN Function Description.

methods.name: ric_control_action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific RIC control action request is supported.

methods.name: execute_ric_control_action
methods.description: Executes a RIC control action asynchronously and returns a response.

methods.name: handle_packed_e2sm_action_definition
methods.description: Unpacks a packed E2SM Action Definition.

methods.name: handle_packed_event_trigger_definition
methods.description: Unpacks a packed E2SM Event Trigger Definition.

methods.name: handle_packed_ric_control_request
methods.description: Unpacks a packed E2 RIC Control Request.

methods.name: pack_ric_control_response
methods.description: Packs an E2SM RIC Control Response.

methods.name: get_e2sm_packer
methods.description: Returns a reference to the E2SM handler for packing/unpacking.

methods.name: action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a RIC action is supported.

methods.name: get_e2sm_report_service
methods.description: Creates and returns a report service for a given action definition.

methods.name: add_e2sm_rc_control_action_executor
methods.description: Adds a control action executor for handling specific control actions.

methods.name: control_request_supported
methods.description: Checks if a control request is supported.

methods.name: handle_packed_event_trigger_definition
methods.description: Unpacks a packed event trigger definition.
